body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 16f638efbddaa88ea035771762e44eacd097921f -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge

What looks good
- The second slice of the Klartext reader is complete and coherent: tapping cycles 206/207 (new `taps.rs`), sub-block cycles 9 and 32 (new `old_cycles.rs`), a shared `hole_levels` helper, and an enforced sub-block order with refusal by line and block number.
- The dangerous-looking parts are handled well: a left-hand rigid tap is refused by name (the spindle would turn against M3), cycle 207 without an S above 0 is refused at the call (a guessed feed is a wrong feed), the cycle-9 dwell is recorded at the 9.1 block, and every Q-parameter, length, feed and dwell is checked finite and in range.
- Tests are strong: pinning tests for the recorded golden `picomax_cycles.nc` (5 stream sections, cycle records, the deep-hole dwell after the last infeed), a truncation sweep and 3000 seeded mutations per golden, all in the existing `klartext` directory suite (no new top-level binary). No new dependencies; no process files, build.rs, scripts, .github or .cargo changes. Provenance lines on both new modules. Body ends with `Refs #2227` and a `Changelog:` line; title is conventional.

Results merged with main (trial merge clean, `b6089ea6e82c0bc47ebb6cf7343b5956684e1126`)

On the self-hosted runner (pr-test.yml): https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/46081590473 — green on the merged tree, head `16f638efb`:
- Quick gate: gcode build (`--no-run`) ok (198s); gcode suites: lib ok; gcode suites: klartext ok; wall 3.5 min, 3 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- Clippy step on the runner failed for an environment reason: `'cargo-clippy' is not installed for the toolchain 'stable-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu'` — a missing component, not a lint finding. Re-run locally on the trial-merged tree (worktree `cc-pr4460-review`): `cargo clippy -p camcraft-gcode --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean (2m04s, 0 warnings).

Targeted tests (step 5)
- No post or toolpath generator changed; no crate depends on `camcraft-gcode` (verified by dependency scan), so no example catalog suites, no light lane and no heavy step are owed. Issue #2227 is P7, not under the P1 safety floor; `camcraft-gcode` does not change posted G-code. No `cfg(windows)`/per-OS readings in the diff, so no local re-runs of a Windows arm.

Requested before merge
1. None blocking. See notes.

Questions / notes
1. `docs/decisions/2227-klartext-reader.md` (second slice section, line ~88) cites `(#4227 cycles, #4095 cycle 32)` — the wrong issue numbers. The correct citations are #4395 (cycles) and #4442 (cycle 32), as the PR body already uses. One-line fix, not blocking.
2. `entry_z` of a Klartext hole cycle (drill and tap) is now the surface Q203 instead of the set-up clearance (`cycles.rs`, `cycle_call` and `taps.rs`). That is a recorded behavior change; it is pinned by `klartext_cycle_golden_reads_back_into_the_stream_motion_and_cycles` and documented in the decision file. Only the `.H` reader and its own goldens consume it today, so no consumer breaks. Worth a glance at the cut.
3. The cycle-206 dwell is recorded in the `Cycle` record but not as a `DwellEvent`, and the 206 motion has no dwell move between feed out and the last rapid. That is consistent with the drill cycle (same shape), and the stream-motion test pins the shape, so it is fine — flagging it so the reviewer does not read it as a missing dwell.
4. Note for the maintainer: the runner's clippy step has been missing the clippy component (`cargo-clippy` is not installed) for this run; the local clippy is clean, but the runner may need `rustup component add clippy` on the toolchain. Not a PR finding.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
